title: End of side one and start of side two, tape four
summary: Smith closes side one, saying the Hayes story is now on record, and reopens side two noting the 1933 union trouble.

blocks.x: Well, you know, people have often wondered why Thamon Hayes left the band and now it's on permanent record why he did and now we will end Side One of Tape Four and we'll be right back with Side Two of Tape Four of the interview with Samuel Baby Lovett by Art Smith, with the very, very able assistance of Crook Goodwin.

And now Side Two, Tape Four, of the interview with Samuel Baby Lovett, with the very, very great help coming from Charles Crook Goodwin. This is yours truly, Art Smith. We ended Side One of the Thamon Hayes saga and he left the band in 1933. I don't believe that that date was mentioned on the other side of this tape. It was 1933, when the trouble with the union occurred.
